lines.text: Andersen climbs up a tall hill and sits on the ground.
He looks up at the sky.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... It really is nice.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: The surface.
He looks down at the scene below him.
He sees a swarm of Raptures covering the entire surface of the ground,
and at the center of that swarm, he sees his comrades fighting,
each one skillfully taking down Raptures in her own way.
Andersen suddenly feels a prickle in his nose as he starts tearing up.
He forces back the wave of emotions, unwilling to take his eyes off the Nikkes as they fight.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... That right there. That's what I'm talking about.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Pierce through!
Light bursts forth from Seven Dwarves, mowing down a group of Raptures.
Snow White unleashes a barrage of missiles as her machine gun sprays bullets.
It looks almost as though there's an invisible line in front of her,
which not even a single Rapture can get past.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Any problems?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The anti-ship rifle is still cooling down.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: How about the missiles?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Two pods are malfunctioning.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: That's pretty bad, isn't it?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It doesn't matter. I have a lot of weapons.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: I think it's safe to say you've finally achieved your dream of being a walking arsenal, so why aren't you walking?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: There's no need. This is the most efficient place to attack from.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Oh, here comes one.
A self-destruct Rapture barrels through the explosions and throws itself at Snow White.
Andersen feels his chest clench.
Snow White has always gotten flustered when faced with unexpected situations.
She doesn't have Liliweiss to take care of—
*Clang!*
Snow White swats the Rapture aside with the long barrel of her anti-ship rifle.
The Rapture is sent flying far away before exploding.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: ... That's your main weapon. You shouldn't use it like a bat or you'll end up breaking it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: If that happens, I'll just use something else.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Heh, I knew you'd be a powerhouse once you became a little more relaxed, but... you really are something.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: I'm okay now.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: It would appear so.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: All right. Keep up the good work.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: They approach without end.
Scarlet swings her sword from inside the horde of Raptures.
Her strikes are fluid, aiming only for their cores. With no wasted movement, she steadily cuts down the Raptures' numbers.
Still, the scenery doesn't change.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: For as much as you move around, the actual number of Raptures you take down leaves a little to be desired.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis so. Would that I had learned to wield a gun.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: You don't mean that.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: True, I spake in jest. Thou feelest my meaning well.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Yeah, because I know you well.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Is that so?

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Have you given up on caring about things like "clean divisions" in a single strike and one-on-one duels?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Experience hath taught me: to anchor oneself to such ideas blunts one's efficiency.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Huh. You're much more well-rounded now. You used to just rush in without hesitation.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: What's wrong? Why'd you get quiet all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Such conversation with thee feels not unfamiliar.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: In former days, we maintained words thus during battle some dozens of times, I take it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: ... Dozens? Try hundreds, or thousands.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Is it so? It grieveth me to not remember.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Don't go getting sentimental on me. Hesitation dulls the blade... or something like that, right?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: My blade dulleth not.
A group of Raptures swarm Scarlet.
Her eyes glint. She crouches down and lets her sword fly.
A metallic sound rings out for a brief moment.
The sound isn't very loud,
yet all the Raptures that swarmed her are cut neatly in half before falling to the ground.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Haha. I thought you didn't care about clean divisions anymore?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: I meant no longer do I cling solely to the practice. To deny an opportunity so openly given would be of ill manner.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: In any case, methinks I understand the nature of thy fellowship with us.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Being thus met, let us be good one to another.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Verily. I too ask for thy good graces, such as I am.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Haha, what manner of personating is that? How fond.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Hyah!
*Booom!*
Raptures are sent flying one after another as they come into contact with Rapunzel's staff.
She swings her staff wildly with excitement, sending Raptures skyward with every strike.
Her delighted cries echo across the battlefield.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Whew...

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Having fun?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Fun...? Yes... Yes, I am. Moreso than I expected.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: After always being the one to defend and heal others, it feels nice to beat on the enemy yourself, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Maybe, but those other things are still what I'm best at. If you need me to switch over, I'll do so right away.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Scarlet and Snow White look a little hurt.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Oh, is that right?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Well, I'm sure it's nothing to worry about. They'll be all right. It's them, after all.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Wow. How very... calm of you. No big fuss?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: It takes too much out of me to react to every little thing.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I decided to trust my comrades more.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: That's wonderful to hear.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Uh-oh. Incoming.
Countless missiles launch from the swarm of Raptures.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Rapunzel. Shield.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Mm... It's okay. Everyone will figure it out.
*Bang! Bang! Bang!*
Explosions of all sizes burst around the battlefield.
Rapunzel dodges them while continuing to swing her staff.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Launching a shield would be the right choice if I had a lot of sisters to protect, but there's no need at the moment.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: ... Excellent intuition. It's better to look at the big picture than to get lost in the weeds, especially for you.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Heh... It's almost unbelievable how much you've all grown.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: There's nothing left for this old man to do.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: ... Just by being here,

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: you're giving us the strength to win, Commander.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: ... I see. Well, keep up the good work.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: All right. Call me if you need me.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Will do.
Dorothy is surprised.
Her stamina doesn't drop no matter what she does. What's more, she feels like she could take a hit and still be fine.
Then there's her overwhelming offensive abilities.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: ... This time, I'll try using this much...
*Pshoom!*
A beam shoots from Dorothy's gun and pierces the Raptures.
Her eyes grow wide.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: This is amazing...

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Hey, Heretic Dorothy. How does it feel to be all powered up?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: If you call me that again, you'll be my next target.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Ooh, I'm scared. Heretics really are different.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Hmph...

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: It's absurd, to be honest. It feels like I can do anything.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Then kill the Queen.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: In a little bit. We have to make sure the Ark ascends first.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Anything to report?

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: andersen_c_op
lines.text: Good. Keep it up.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: All right.
After speaking with everyone, Andersen looks again at the battlefield.
He can't take his eyes off his teammates.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Yeah... This is why the surface is so great.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Oh! I think I see the end!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Great! There are no more reinforcements coming! All we have to do is take those things down!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'm going to destroy the last one! Then I'll take all the credit for myself!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Cutey! What kind of magic did you use to do this?
The Four Beasts and the Goddess Squad completely cut the Raptures off up ahead!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Haha! Serves you right, you dumb Raptures!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That's harsh, mocking someone when they're already down.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wanna play a game? Let's see who can take out the most Raptures!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: What? I mean, I don't mind, but Rapi and I have probably killed ten times as many as you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Neon is in first. It's rather upsetting.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Th-then let's start counting from now. How about it?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Hm... Sure, okay. I guess we can give up our lead.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: Anis's fighting spirit extends even to her comrades...! She never ceases to amaze...!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Must be nice, being able to view everything through a positive lens like that.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Oh, let her have this. She's just excited to work with Anis.
Keep it up, everyone! Just a little—

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: You call yourself a Commander when all you ever do is cheer from the sidelines?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: That is why you're still a hack.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Hi, C-Commander. We're here, hehe.

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hey, Commander. Looking just as handsome as ever.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Hm?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Absolute.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Why is Absolute suddenly poppin' up out of nowhere?

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: P-popping up...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What I meant is, what've you been doing this whole time that you're only now getting here?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I never took you for the inquisitive type.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: How about you just leave? Instead of coming when we're practically done and then acting like you did anything.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, yeah!

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: B-but there are still so many left...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hmph! You've got eyes, right? Then use them! Does that look like a lot to you?

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hmm... Yeah, it does.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Oh. Well, you've got good eyes then.
Seriously, though. What have you been doing?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: We just got back from a secret mission.

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: I'll tell you later. For now, let's focus on the Ark's ascent.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Yeah, okay. Sounds good.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: This time we'll see once and for all who's the strongest!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Still obsessing over that, are you?

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: ... Fine, I'll play along.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: Y-you say it like that, but we all know you're actually happy to be included...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe. I think acting like that is part of the fun for her.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This reminds me of old times.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Same here.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah, even though a lot is different now.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander, we should also compete to see who's the strongest.
Go for it. Do me proud.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... It's great to see such friendly rivalry.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Is that what it looks like to you?

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: What, are you jealous?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Well... I'd be lying if I said no.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Take away the Ark Buster, and we can't hold a candle to any of them.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: I'm sure they were once like us.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: All we have to do is keep moving forward and not give up.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: That's something both you and Red are great at.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Don't try to squirrel your way out of it.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Oh, you're gonna include me too?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Of course. We can't be the only two doing all the hard work.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Hehe. Aww, that's too bad.
Let's go, everyone!
There are no more Rapture reinforcements coming.
The once seemingly endless stream of Raptures has noticeably decreased.
The battlefield is starting to thin out.
I look around at everyone's faces.
I see... certainty.
Each of their expressions is filled with certainty.
This is it. We've done it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Commander. It's time.
... Right.
Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Yes?
We're ready.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Enikk, begin the broadcast.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Initiating broadcast to the entire Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: We will now begin the Ark ascent sequence.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: There will be tremors and loud noises, but know that you are in no danger.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Please follow the directions of your shelter guides.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Additionally, please remain in the shelters until the ascent is complete and the situation has been resolved.

lines.speaker: ingrid
lines.text: Listen up! Humanity is finally going to the surface!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The time has come to take back our land from the Raptures!

lines.speaker: mustang
lines.text: Everyone! Are you ready to see le new world?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... We're really going to the surface.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yep ♡

lines.speaker: jackal
lines.text: Hehe! Hehehe!

lines.speaker: rosanna
lines.text: Let's do it. Up we go.

lines.speaker: sakura
lines.text: Let us ascend.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Here we gooo!

lines.speaker: poli
lines.text: We're finally doing it. We're going up.

lines.speaker: miranda
lines.text: Yes! I'm so excited!

lines.speaker: quiry
lines.text: S-same here...! B-but more afraid than excited...!

lines.speaker: privaty
lines.text: ... We're going up. All of us.

lines.speaker: yulha
lines.text: Yeah, let's go.

lines.speaker: admi
lines.text: Yes, let us all go up. Together.

lines.speaker: elegg
lines.text: Hehe! I'm glad we get to work together up on the surface too, Ms. Trony.

lines.speaker: trony
lines.text: Y-yeah. Me too, Elegg

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Finally.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: The Ark... It's really coming to the surface.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, man! My heart is racing!

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: ... They're coming up.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Yeah. Finally.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Mwahaha... Now the entire surface will be a playground for my villainy.

lines.speaker: vesti_t
lines.text: E-Eunhwa, Emma. The Ark's coming up...

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: emma_t
lines.text: Hehe, you're allowed to express your happiness a bit more, you know.

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: ... We can't let our guard down until the very end.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: Yeah, of course.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: This feels like a dream.
Once the Ark ascends, I need everyone to keep their complete focus on the battle.
We can't let a single stray bullet reach the Ark.
Everyone has determination written across their faces.
We look at the enemies before us.
The Third Surface Reclamation War begins now!
Let us rise up!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The Ark's ascent is complete.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Dispatch all forces outside the Ark to form a perimeter, then have them take defensive positions.
It's here... The Ark.
Suddenly, a loud sound roars across the sky.
The AZX comes flying from the Ark, its horn blaring.
It stirs up a cloud of dust as it stops in front of us.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Is that...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: A train!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Infinity Rail!
I'm getting déjà vu...

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Yee-ha! Commando squad, do you read?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Infinity Rail will take you where you need to go, all the way to fight the Queen.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Get on! Quick!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: We'll depart once everyone has boarded.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: All passengers, please hurry on board.
Absolute! Let's go!

lines.speaker: eunhwa_t
lines.text: Roger that.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: We're coming too!
Not yet! Matis and the Ark Rangers can join after you resupply!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: That's ridiculous! You're just trying to take all the glory for yourselves!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Do what Cutey says. If we rush over there now, all we could really do is serve as decoys.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Ugh...! Okay, Birdie! We'll recharge and be right there!

lines.speaker: black
lines.text: We'll catch up too! Go on ahead!
*Whoosh!*
The Wings of Victory flies overhead.
It heads toward where its true masters are, far away.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Looks like they've already gotten started over there.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We should get going too.
Commence counterattack! We must save Marian...
and take down the Queen!
The Goddess Squad gazes at the enormous city stretching high above the surface off in the distance.
The entire scene feels surreal, a feeling only eclipsed by the elation it inspires in those looking at it.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: ... They made it.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: That's... the Ark...

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Humanity's final city...

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis bigger than methought.

lines.speaker: dorothy_g
lines.text: Finally...
*Whoosh!*
The Wings of Victory stops above the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: sky
lines.text: We're here to pick you up!

lines.speaker: sora
lines.text: The final battle is about to begin ☆

lines.speaker: cielo
lines.text: It's an honor to be part of this with all of you, members of the Goddess Squad.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: All right, everyone get on.

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: Let's ride this thing over, make short work of the Queen,

lines.speaker: andersen_c
lines.text: and then we'll all sit down for a meal.
